name: com.mckrill.avbd
description: GPU-resident Augmented Vertex Block Descent (AVBD) physics for Unity: rigid bodies, joints and soft bodies solved entirely on the GPU and rendered through URP.

samples.description: Runs the CPU reference solver live in a scene: upstream demo scenes, sequential versus colored sweep, graph-color tint, contact and joint overlays.
A pyramid of 140 or more boxes on the GPU solver. Shoot boxes from the camera and adjust their speed, size and mass in the panel. Needs the contact stages in AvbdSolver.Step().
